title: Bulletin-first communication
description: Route inter-role signals through Society Bulletin each cycle so communications are witnessable and not lost in siloed state.

title: Artifact footprint rule
description: Require at least one concrete artifact file under society/artifacts per growth cycle so 'build' leaves a durable footprint.

title: Gather synthesis pass
description: After tribute, memory_weaver/pathfinder synthesize topic coverage gaps into a candidate gather note — still not accepted.

title: Improvement candidacy discipline
description: Tag all self-improvement attempts as candidate process changes; refuse any path that would promote without human authorize.

title: Forum of Exchange cadence
description: Have Forum members exchange one build / one gather / one improve signal per cycle via herald messages.
